_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV decroissante : Total Backlog (visibilite 6-10 ans), BCA Rev (segment cle Boeing), BCA Backlog, Defense Rev, Global Services Rev.

kpis.signal: Visibilite revenue 6-10 ans, pilier de la these Boeing
kpis.description_fr: Carnet de commandes consolide BCA + BDS + BGS. Visibilite revenue plurianuelle, indicateur cle aerospatial. ~84% BCA en FY24.
kpis.description_en: Consolidated backlog BCA + BDS + BGS. Multi-year revenue visibility, key aerospace metric. ~84% BCA in FY24.

kpis.signal: Recul 2024 lie aux problemes 737 MAX (grounding janvier 2024) et baisse livraisons
kpis.description_fr: Revenus segment Commercial Airplanes (737, 767, 777, 787). Cyclique avec grounding 737-9 janvier 2024. -33% YoY a cause baisse livraisons.
kpis.description_en: Commercial Airplanes segment revenues (737, 767, 777, 787). Cyclical, hit by 737-9 grounding Jan 2024. -33% YoY on lower deliveries.

kpis.signal: Carnet BCA stable ~$435Mds, environ 80% avec compagnies non-US
kpis.description_fr: Carnet de commandes Commercial Airplanes. Vision multi-annee livraisons jets civils. ~80% non-US.
kpis.description_en: Commercial Airplanes backlog. Multi-year jet delivery visibility. ~80% non-US airlines.

kpis.signal: Segment defense stable ~24 Mds, expose aux programmes fixed-price avec pertes
kpis.description_fr: Revenus Defense, Space & Security (avions militaires, missiles, satellites). Pression programmes fixed-price (KC-46, T-7A, MQ-25).
kpis.description_en: Defense, Space & Security revenue (military aircraft, missiles, satellites). Pressure from fixed-price programs (KC-46, T-7A, MQ-25).

kpis.signal: Croissance reguliere services apres-vente (pieces, maintenance, formation)
kpis.description_fr: Revenus Global Services (services apres-vente, pieces, MRO, formation). Segment recurrent et plus profitable.
kpis.description_en: Global Services revenue (aftermarket, parts, MRO, training). Recurring, more profitable segment.

_notes: Source : 10-K Boeing FY20-FY24 SEC EDGAR. Histories chaines via 3 filings (2022, 2024, 2025).
